messages:
Support Escalation: heads up — multiple dedicated pool customers reporting dramatic tail latency increases (p95/p99) since ~05:02 UTC. Affected: preview workload + interactive chat. Tickets: INC-4612, INC-4613.
Priya Nair: looking at metrics. dedicated-pool-west p95 jumped 150ms -> 760ms, p99 spiked to ~9.4s. No obvious traffic spike in request count.
Ben Wallace: any recent infra changes?
deploy-bot: deploy 1912350001 (autoscaler-controller) succeeded at 05:00 UTC by eng-runtime.
Theo Lin: that deploy included an attach backoff refactor (PR #857). It added a rate-limiter for simultaneous attach attempts and exponential backoff with no jitter.
Kara Singh: logs from attach controller show a lot of queued attach requests then long waits. snippet:
```
[05:03:10] attach_request pool=dedicated-west req=Z-81
[05:03:10] allowed=false reason=rate_limited
[05:03:11] queued_pos=12
[05:03:12] backoff_ms=500
[05:03:14] backoff_ms=1500
[05:03:17] backoff_ms=4500
[05:03:22] attach_success pod=dwest-09 latency_ms=5100
```
Priya Nair: attach_rate_limit_rejections jumped from 0 -> 22/s at 05:01. Provisioning backlog increased to 21.
Ben Wallace: so autoscaler is creating nodes, but attach controller is delaying connections causing long cold-gpu attach times. That would explain p99 spikes without throughput change.
Support Escalation: several customers escalated (MapSeat, RetailFlow). They want ETA.
Kara Singh: short term options: 1) disable the new rate-limiter (feature flag), 2) raise min_replicas for dedicated-west, 3) route excess load to hosted fallback for non-sensitive tenants.
Theo Lin: disabling flag is fastest. But we should also add temporary headroom. I can bump min_replicas from 2->5 for that pool.
Ben Wallace: do it regionally only. Also, enable a fallback route for customers that allow hosted processing (we have tenant consent metadata).
infra-bot: autoscaler scaling request accepted: setting min_replicas=5 for dedicated-west.
Priya Nair: feature gate `attach_backoff_v2` toggled OFF at 05:08 UTC by Theo.
Theo Lin: kicked off prewarm for newly scheduled nodes: `./ops/prewarm --pool dedicated-west --nodes 3`. Prewarm logs:
```
[05:09] node-21: prewarm ok
[05:09] node-22: prewarm ok
[05:10] node-23: prewarm ok
```
Kara Singh: after actions, p95 dropped from 760ms -> 210ms and p99 from 9.4s -> 1.1s within ~6 minutes. Customers notified.
Support Escalation: MapSeat acknowledged and downgraded urgency. RetailFlow still wants a timeline.
Ben Wallace: root cause hypothesis: new backoff + no jitter + insufficient spare capacity for dedicated pools caused attach storms during warmup events. The exponential without jitter synchronized retries and amplified tail.
Priya Nair: immediate follow-ups: revert deploy in prod, add jitter and cap multiplier, and add attach queue-aware behavior: if provisioning backlog > X, reduce backoff multiplier.
Theo Lin: long-term: autoscaler should maintain dynamic headroom based on active customer count and recent attach failure rate. Suggest formula: spare = max(2, ceil(active_tenants * 0.08)). Create INF ticket.
Kara Singh: create DEVEX task for automating prewarm on instance attach; avoid manual scripts.
Ben Wallace: repro plan: run synthetic ramp in staging: `./tools/loadgen --pool dedicated-west --rps 120 --duration 12m` with backoff_v2 enabled to validate fix. Also test with jitter/cap.
Priya Nair: I'm creating follow-up tickets: SRE-1263 (tune attach backoff + jitter), INF-990 (autoscaler headroom heuristic), DEVEX-454 (prewarm daemon). Assign owners and due dates.
infra-bot: incident status updated -> mitigated at 05:16 UTC. Monitoring window 60m.
Support Escalation: please add post-incident summary and timeline to #postmortems. Customers want assurance this won't recur.
Theo Lin: postmortem items: timeline, code diff (PR #857), evidence (metrics/log snippets), fixes rolled, testing plan, rollback steps, owner list.
Kara Singh: rollback plan: re-enable `attach_backoff_v2` flag and restore min_replicas=2 if we see no regression for 1 hour after patches. Observation windows: 15m after each change.
Ben Wallace: assigning owners: Theo (backoff fix), Priya (autoscaler headroom), Kara (prewarm automation), Ben (customer comms).
Priya Nair: monitoring shows stable p99 ~ 920ms after mitigation window. Will update support and close incident when stable.
Support Escalation: thanks team — keep customer comms updated. Postmortem link requested here once drafted. :white_check_mark:
Theo Lin: adding one more note: add metric attach_retry_sync_rate to detect synchronized retries; trigger early warning.
Kara Singh: ack. I'll add that to INF-990.
Priya Nair: incident mitigated at 05:16 UTC. Will keep watching until 06:16 UTC and then close.
Support Escalation: ACK and thanks.
